2607.03593.title: An Interpretable Deep Learning Framework for Discovery and Clinical Validation of Deep Radiomic Signatures in Tumor Classification
2607.03593.paper_summary: Imaging signatures are quantitative features extracted from medical images that provide clinically meaningful information for tumor diagnosis, characterization, prognosis, and treatment planning. Although deep learning has shown great potential for imaging signature discovery, its limited interpretability remains a major barrier to clinical adoption. Existing approaches often achieve high predictive performance but provide little biological insight into the identified signatures. We propose a unified framework for interpretable imaging signature discovery by integrating deep learning based segmentation, explainable classification, and radiomic analysis. A robust segmentation model is first used to accurately delineate tumors, followed by a Grad-CAM guided pipeline that identifies diagnostically important regions as candidate imaging signatures. A mutual information based adaptive thresholding strategy enables patient-specific signature extraction. The resulting signatures are validated using a downstream deep learning classification model, while radiomic features extracted from the signature regions are evaluated with traditional machine learning models and interpreted using SHAP to identify the most discriminative biomarkers. The proposed framework is evaluated on the public BUSI breast ultrasound, KiTS renal CT, and BraTS brain tumor datasets, as well as a private UF Health renal CT cohort. Compared with conventional whole-tumor radiomics, the proposed signature-based approach achieves improved discriminative performance while providing greater biological interpretability. By converting deep learning attention into reproducible quantitative imaging biomarkers, this framework offers an interpretable and reproducible solution for non-invasive tumor characterization and imaging biomarker discovery.
2607.03593.paper_summary_zh: 影像特徵是從醫學影像中提取的定量特徵，提供對腫瘤診斷、特徵描述、預後和治療計劃具有臨床意義的信息。儘管深度學習在影像特徵發現方面顯示出巨大的潛力，但其有限的可解釋性仍然是臨床應用的一大障礙。現有的方法通常能夠實現高預測性能，但對所識別的特徵提供的生物學見解卻很少。我們提出了一個統一的可解釋影像特徵發現框架，通過整合深度學習基於的分割、可解釋的分類和放射組學分析來實現。首先使用一個穩健的分割模型準確地劃定腫瘤，然後通過一個Grad-CAM引導的流程識別診斷上重要的區域作為候選影像特徵。一種基於互信息的自適應閾值策略使得能夠提取特定患者的特徵。所得到的特徵使用下游深度學習分類模型進行驗證，同時從特徵區域提取的放射組學特徵則使用傳統機器學習模型進行評估，並通過SHAP解釋以識別最具區分性的生物標記。所提出的框架在公共的BUSI乳腺超聲、KiTS腎CT和BraTS腦腫瘤數據集，以及一個私人的UF Health腎CT隊列上進行了評估。與傳統的整個腫瘤放射組學相比，所提出的基於特徵的方法實現了更好的區分性能，同時提供了更大的生物學可解釋性。通過將深度學習注意力轉換為可重複的定量影像生物標記，這一框架為非侵入性腫瘤特徵描述和影像生物標記發現提供了一個可解釋且可重複的解決方案。
